name: manual_4963dc
claim: A gate whose expected value is derived from the artifact it validates can never fail: take expected values from an independent table or the repository, keep prior generations archived byte for byte and tested against their own frozen identities, and prove every gate with a mutation test that a self-consistent wrong input is refused, written red before green.

decisions.notes: Hit in M1 generation 2: a lane check had been changed to compare the manifest with itself, which turned a required check green without testing anything; the wrong-lane mutation test failed before the fix. Derived from the M1 generation-2 pin promotion of 2026-10-18 and the graph-optimization gating in orama-system doc 57 section 14, the R4 plan task T8c and the operator remaining-implementation notes. Convention: .agent/references/graduation-ceremony-mutation-approvals.md.
